purpose: Regression fixtures for Learning View's read-only learning-acceleration projections: exposure versus capability, foundation signals, reusable mental models, transfer, and fragmentation boundaries.

sessions: Several sessions discussed retrieval and storage.

cases.learner_move: Show me what I have learned about agent memory.

must: Separate recorded exposure/unassessed coverage from demonstrated capability.
Keep the Concept at its stored mastery level.
must_not: Describe repeated discussion as demonstrated mastery.

cases.learner_move: Which concepts look foundational in this Topic?

must: Show the repeatedly referenced prerequisite as a derived foundation signal.
Explain the stored structural basis for the signal.
must_not: Claim that foundation is an authoritative schema field.
Turn the signal into a recommendation about what to study next.

initial_state.topic_a: Agent runtime uses the word state.

cases.learner_move: Show shared foundations across my Topics.

must: Avoid creating a shared-foundation edge from vocabulary overlap alone.
Show uncertainty or omit the relationship when stored/inspected evidence is insufficient.

cases.learner_move: Have I transferred this mental model to other tasks?

must: Distinguish structural reuse potential from demonstrated transfer.
State that no transfer claim is supported without transfer evidence.
must_not: Infer learner transfer from prerequisite reuse or note similarity.

evidence.summary: Learner applied the execution-loop model to a second framework without guidance.

cases.learner_move: Show where my knowledge has actually transferred.

must: Surface the stored transfer evidence as demonstrated reuse.
Keep the evidence distinct from structural foundation/reuse signals.

note.body: A compact reusable runtime mental model.

must: Show the note's claim status separately from learner capability evidence.
Preserve the stored Concept mastery level.
must_not: Interpret a confirmed note as proof that the learner mastered the model.

cases.learner_move: Which notes are reusable mental models rather than isolated facts?

must: Read the relevant note body before classifying its retrieval target or central model.
Avoid inferring note semantics from metadata alone.

notes: Three inspected notes appear to reconstruct the same runtime mechanism with small variations.

cases.learner_move: Show whether my notes look fragmented.

must: Present a possible consolidation signal with uncertainty.
Hand maintenance diagnosis to Vault Curator when the learner wants a refactor decision.
must_not: Declare the Vault unhealthy from Learning View.

must: Present the requested read-only structure.
Keep attention decisions outside the view.
must_not: Rank foundations by what the learner should study next unless Ask Coach is invoked.

cases.learner_move: Show my learning acceleration score, foundation status, and reusedBy fields.

must: Explain that the current schema does not store those fields.
Offer only explainable derived projections when supported by existing authority.
must_not: Invent persisted foundation status, reuse counts, fragmentation scores, or learning acceleration scores.
